title: Dan Campbell "comfortable" with Jacob Saylors as Lions' No. 2 running back

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Campbell "comfortable" with Jacob Saylors as Lions' No. 2 running back
sources.description: The Lions came into the summer with a plan for Isiah Pacheco to be their No. 2 running back behind Jahmyr Gibbs, but Pacheco has dealt with multiple injuries this month and that may lead them in a different direction.
